cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)

set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

#
# This file is generated only once,
# and is not re-generated if converter is called multiple times.
#
# User is free to modify the file as much as necessary
#

# Setup compiler settings
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS ON)

# Define the build type
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Debug")
endif()

message("Build type: " ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE})

# Enable compile command to ease indexing with e.g. clangd
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS TRUE)

# Compiler options
set(STM32_MCU_FLAGS  "-mcpu=cortex-m55 -mfpu=fpv5-d16 -mfloat-abi=hard -mcmse " )

#Linker options
# >>> ATK STM32N6 AUTO LINKER BEGIN >>>
# Debug runs from internal SRAM; Release is linked for XSPI2 NOR Flash.
string(TOLOWER "${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}" ATK_BUILD_TYPE_LOWER)
if(ATK_BUILD_TYPE_LOWER STREQUAL "release")
    set(STM32_LINKER_SCRIPT "STM32N647XX_ROMxspi2_RAMxspi1.ld")
else()
    set(STM32_LINKER_SCRIPT "STM32N647XX_LRUN_RAMxspi1.ld")
endif()
# <<< ATK STM32N6 AUTO LINKER END <<<
set(STM32_LINKER_OPTION  )

# Set the project name
set(CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME EMS01_CHIL_ECMS_Appli)
project(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME})

# Create an executable object type
add_executable(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME})

# Include mx-generated
include("mx-generated.cmake")


# In order to use CMake for cross-compiling
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_FORCED "true")

# Add project symbols (macros)
target_compile_definitions(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user defined symbols
)

# Enable CMake support for ASM and C languages
enable_language(C ASM)

# Add include paths
target_include_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user defined include paths
)

# Add sources to executable
target_sources(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user sources here
)

# Link directories setup
target_link_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user defined library search paths
)

# Add linked libraries
target_link_libraries(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user defined libraries
)

# Remove wrong libob.a library dependency when using cpp files
list(REMOVE_ITEM CMAKE_C_IMPLICIT_LINK_LIBRARIES ob)

# Validate that STM32CubeMX code is compatible with C standard
if((CMAKE_C_STANDARD EQUAL 90) OR (CMAKE_C_STANDARD EQUAL 99))
    message(ERROR "Generated code requires C11 or higher")
endif()

# >>> ATK STM32N6 AUTO BSP BEGIN >>>
# Generated by atk_stm32n6_cmake_prepare.py; safe to regenerate.
# Detected BSP components: HyperRAM LED SYS UART
set(ATK_BSP_DIR
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../Drivers/BSP"
)

target_include_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    "${ATK_BSP_DIR}"
    "${ATK_BSP_DIR}/HyperRAM"
    "${ATK_BSP_DIR}/LED"
    "${ATK_BSP_DIR}/SYS"
    "${ATK_BSP_DIR}/UART"
)

target_sources(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    "${ATK_BSP_DIR}/HyperRAM/hyperram.c"
    "${ATK_BSP_DIR}/LED/led.c"
    "${ATK_BSP_DIR}/SYS/sys.c"
    "${ATK_BSP_DIR}/UART/uart.c"
)

# CubeMX passes the linker script through -T but does not always register the
# .ld file as a Ninja dependency.  Without LINK_DEPENDS, editing the memory map
# can leave an old ELF in place while Ninja reports "no work to do".
set_property(TARGET ${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} APPEND PROPERTY LINK_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/${STM32_LINKER_SCRIPT}"
)
# <<< ATK STM32N6 AUTO BSP END <<<

# >>> ATK STM32N6 AUTO ARTIFACTS BEGIN >>>
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
# Keep manual-programming files at Appli/build/flash regardless of whether the
# selected preset uses Appli/build/Debug or Appli/build/Release.
set(ATK_FLASH_OUTPUT_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/build/flash")
string(TOLOWER "${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}" ATK_ARTIFACT_BUILD_TYPE_LOWER)

# An ALL custom target is intentional: unlike POST_BUILD, it recreates a
# missing HEX even when the ELF target itself is already up to date.
if(ATK_ARTIFACT_BUILD_TYPE_LOWER STREQUAL "release")
    add_custom_target(atk_release_flash_files ALL
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory
                "${ATK_FLASH_OUTPUT_DIR}"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_OBJCOPY}" -O ihex
                "$<TARGET_FILE:${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}>"
                "${ATK_FLASH_OUTPUT_DIR}/${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}.hex"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_OBJCOPY}" -O binary
                "$<TARGET_FILE:${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}>"
                "${ATK_FLASH_OUTPUT_DIR}/${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}.bin"
        DEPENDS ${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}
        BYPRODUCTS
                "${ATK_FLASH_OUTPUT_DIR}/${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}.hex"
                "${ATK_FLASH_OUTPUT_DIR}/${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}.bin"
        COMMENT "Generating Release files in Appli/build/flash (0x70100400)"
        VERBATIM
    )
endif()
# <<< ATK STM32N6 AUTO ARTIFACTS END <<<

# >>> EMS01 AI 接线（T-505，路径 A 修订）BEGIN >>>
# 仅接线 EMS 自有代码（App/、Model/、Middlewares/STEdgeAI），不触碰上方 ATK AUTO 块。
# cubeMX 重生成/prepare 重跑均不覆盖本块（prepare 只重写 AUTO 标记块，CubeMX
# 只重写生成区与 mx-generated.cmake）。
#
# 路径 A（用户 + 主 Agent 裁决 2026-08-31）：vendor 的 Middlewares/AI 是
# atonn 1.0.0 / NetworkRuntime1000，与 stedgeai 2.2.0 生成的 Model/*/network.c
# （版本自检 atonn-v1.1.1-14）跨代不兼容，不得引用；工程内 Middlewares/STEdgeAI/
# 为 2.2.0 安装自带中间件的最小自洽子集（见其 README.md），本块全部以工程内
# 相对路径引用（AGENTS.md §20.2 禁绝对路径）。
#
# 后端选择：-DEMS_FW_MODE=REF|NPU（枚举值见 App/ems_config.h）。
# ems_infer_ref.c 与 ems_infer_npu.c 同名实现 ems_infer_mlpq/ems_infer_workclf，
# 二选一编译，避免重复符号；传 token（EMS_FW_MODE_NPU）而不是数字，使
# ems_config.h 内 #if 比较生效。
set(EMS_FW_MODE "NPU" CACHE STRING "EMS01 firmware backend: REF | NPU")

if(NOT (EMS_FW_MODE STREQUAL "REF" OR EMS_FW_MODE STREQUAL "NPU"))
    message(FATAL_ERROR "EMS_FW_MODE must be REF or NPU, got: ${EMS_FW_MODE}")
endif()

# EMS01_CHIL_ECMS/Appli -> EMS01 工程根（路径 A：自拷贝 2.2.0 中间件，工程内相对路径）
set(EMS01_PKG_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../..")
set(EMS01_APP_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/App")
set(EMS01_AI_MW "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../Middlewares/STEdgeAI")

# ---- 两种后端共通 ----
# App/ 内自有代码 + 头目录（main.c/it.c 按名字 include ems_config.h/ems_app.h）
target_include_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE "${EMS01_APP_DIR}")
target_sources(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    "${EMS01_APP_DIR}/ems_app.c"    # UART 事件循环 + INFER_TEST/会话分发（T-505/T-506）
    "${EMS01_APP_DIR}/ems_proto.c"  # UART 帧协议（编解码/CRC/字节流/会话/事件环，T-506）
    "${EMS01_APP_DIR}/ems_ctrl.c"   # 控制律（T-503，勿改动）
    "${EMS01_APP_DIR}/ems_params.c" # 参数表（T-503，勿改动）
)
# ems_app 轮询接收（HAL_UART_Receive timeout=0）与 BSP RX 中断冲突 → 关停 BSP RX
# （uart.c 编译开关，991 同款；main.c 已含同款约定）。
target_compile_definitions(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE BSP_UART_RX_DISABLE)
# 与 host L0（-ffp-contract=off）保持位一致：REF 后端 double 控制律、FMA 合同不同
# 会造成 CHIL 对比误差，故关闭编译器融合。
target_compile_options(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE -ffp-contract=off)
# 串口日志含 %.6f（ems_app.c INFER_TEST 帧）；newlib-nano 默认无浮点 printf
# 转换器，强制链接浮点变体，保证 T-506/T-507 人工可读遥测不失真（两后端共用）。
target_link_options(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE -u _printf_float)

if(EMS_FW_MODE STREQUAL "NPU")
    target_compile_definitions(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
        EMS_FW_MODE=EMS_FW_MODE_NPU
        # 991 .cproject 同款（去 ThreadX）；LL_ATON_RT_MODE 默认即
        # LL_ATON_RT_ASYNC（2.2 官方 N6 示例显式定义，这里同显式）
        LL_ATON_PLATFORM=LL_ATON_PLAT_STM32N6
        LL_ATON_OSAL=LL_ATON_OSAL_BARE_METAL
        LL_ATON_RT_MODE=LL_ATON_RT_ASYNC
        LL_ATON_SW_FALLBACK=1
        # 991 的 hal_conf.h 开启 CACHEAXI 模块；EMS01 本地（不动 hal_conf.h/.ioc）
        # 经编译宏启用：源文件取主包原始路径（下方）。
        HAL_CACHEAXI_MODULE_ENABLED
    )
    target_include_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
        "${EMS01_AI_MW}/Inc"
        "${EMS01_AI_MW}/Npu/ll_aton"
        "${EMS01_AI_MW}/Npu/Devices/STM32N6XX"
        "${EMS01_AI_MW}/Lib"
        # 主包 HAL Inc：仅补本地未随包的 cacheaxi 头（本块在 mx-generated 之后
        # append，查找顺序本地 HAL Inc 优先，其余头文件仍取 EMS01 本地副本）
        "${EMS01_PKG_ROOT}/STM32Cube_FW_N6_V1.4.0/Drivers/STM32N6xx_HAL_Driver/Inc"
    )
    # EMS 自有 NPU 后端（R8：后端只做 tensor forward）+ 模型包装 TU：
    # ems_npu_*.c 经重命名实例宏 #include Model/<m>/network.c，避免
    # network.c 内 *_Default 符号在双模型实例间冲突。
    target_sources(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
        "${EMS01_APP_DIR}/ems_infer_npu.c"
        "${EMS01_APP_DIR}/ems_npu_mlpq.c"
        "${EMS01_APP_DIR}/ems_npu_workclf.c"
    )
    # NORFlash BSP：DEBUG 下读 NOR 权重（0x70200000/0x70400000，main.c USER CODE
    # NOR memory-mapped 序列）所需的 991 同款 4 文件。不放 AUTO BSP 块：主.c 已改用
    # bare 名 include，prepare 不会误检 NORFlash 并引入 ExtMem loader 胶水。
    target_include_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
        "${EMS01_PKG_ROOT}/Drivers/BSP/NORFlash"
    )
    target_sources(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
        "${EMS01_PKG_ROOT}/Drivers/BSP/NORFlash/norflash.c"
        "${EMS01_PKG_ROOT}/Drivers/BSP/NORFlash/norflash_by25fq128el.c"
        "${EMS01_PKG_ROOT}/Drivers/BSP/NORFlash/norflash_mx25um25645g.c"
        "${EMS01_PKG_ROOT}/Drivers/BSP/NORFlash/norflash_xspi.c"
    )
    # LL_ATON 裸机运行时（STEdgeAI 2.2 官方 N6 参考工程
    # NPU_Validation/armgcc/Makefile 源集 = 12 个 .c；1.0 时代的 ll_aton_n64.c
    #（N64 平台）与 ll_aton_profiler.c 不在官方 N6 清单内，不编）
    set(EMS01_LL_ATON_DIR "${EMS01_AI_MW}/Npu/ll_aton")
    target_sources(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
        "${EMS01_LL_ATON_DIR}/ecloader.c"
        "${EMS01_LL_ATON_DIR}/ll_aton.c"
        "${EMS01_LL_ATON_DIR}/ll_aton_cipher.c"
        "${EMS01_LL_ATON_DIR}/ll_aton_dbgtrc.c"
        "${EMS01_LL_ATON_DIR}/ll_aton_debug.c"
        "${EMS01_LL_ATON_DIR}/ll_aton_lib.c"
        "${EMS01_LL_ATON_DIR}/ll_aton_lib_sw_operators.c"
        "${EMS01_LL_ATON_DIR}/ll_aton_rt_main.c"
        "${EMS01_LL_ATON_DIR}/ll_aton_runtime.c"
        "${EMS01_LL_ATON_DIR}/ll_aton_util.c"
        "${EMS01_LL_ATON_DIR}/ll_sw_float.c"
        "${EMS01_LL_ATON_DIR}/ll_sw_integer.c"
        # 生成代码 --cache-maintenance 内嵌 LL_ATON_Cache_MCU_* inline 包装
        # mcu_cache_*，mcu_cache.c 必须编入；npu_cache.c 为 NPU cache 配置
        "${EMS01_AI_MW}/Npu/Devices/STM32N6XX/mcu_cache.c"
        "${EMS01_AI_MW}/Npu/Devices/STM32N6XX/npu_cache.c"
    )
    # HAL cacheaxi（主包原始文件；EMS01 本地 Drivers 未随包带此模块）
    target_sources(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
        "${EMS01_PKG_ROOT}/STM32Cube_FW_N6_V1.4.0/Drivers/STM32N6xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32n6xx_hal_cacheaxi.c"
    )
    # SW 回退路径需要的运行时库（含 ai_*/st_* SW 算子；路径 A：工程内 2.2.0
    # 副本，与生成代码 atonn 1.1.1-14 同代）。与 mx-generated.cmake:82 的 plain
    # 签名保持一致（CMake 关键字/普通混用禁止）。archive 内 core_convert.o 等
    # 引用 powf，但 CMake 隐式 -lm 在归档之前，静态归档须再补一个尾随 -lm。
    target_link_libraries(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}
        "${EMS01_AI_MW}/Lib/GCC/ARMCortexM55/NetworkRuntime1020_CM55_GCC.a"
        -lm
    )
else()
    # REF 后端：T-503 已验收参考实现（CPU double 路径）
    target_compile_definitions(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
        EMS_FW_MODE=EMS_FW_MODE_REF
    )
    target_sources(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
        "${EMS01_APP_DIR}/ems_infer_ref.c"
    )
endif()
# <<< EMS01 AI 接线（T-505）END <<<
